label: Address
description: Street address where the work is needed.

label: Town
description: Town or city of the service address.

label: Service needed
description: repair, replace (new equipment / upgrade), maintenance, or question.

label: Trade
description: One of: hvac, electrical, solar, other.

label: Equipment
description: Type of equipment of concern, with brand and age if known.

label: Heating fuel
description: oil, natural gas, electricity, or other (for replacements and upgrades).

label: Problem
description: The caller's problem in their own words, as close to word-for-word as possible.

label: Safety concerns
description: Gas smell, CO alarm, sparks, water near electrical, vulnerable people without heat/cooling, etc. 'none' if none.

label: Customer number
description: Best number to reach the customer, as +1 followed by 10 digits.

label: Best time to call
description: The best time to call the customer back.

label: Home for a visit
description: When the caller can be home for a visit.

label: Access notes
description: Pets, gate codes, parking, which door, etc.

label: Message
description: For non-service calls: who they want and why.
